summary: PinnedForm.lean re-proves five lemmas that located Mathlib declarations (Matrix.transpose_map, Matrix.map_mul, Matrix.map_add, Matrix.map_zero) and an existing in-repo private lemma directly replace, and the new StepTranspose.lean tabulates 145 lines of transposed step data that Matrix.IsDoubleStep.mul_apply plus the existing isDoubleStep_multiplicationOperator/isStep_rootMatrix already provide. RaisingDerivation.lean and LoweringDerivation.lean are byte-identical clones of one ten-line proof script eight times over.
